resolvedSectionBreaks.before:
Silver and copper are metals with good electrical conductivity.
Solutions containing mobile ions can conduct current, but not all aqueous solutions conduct equally well.
An ionized gas is called a plasma, and its charged particles can also carry current.
resolvedSectionBreaks.after:
Another important class of materials is called semiconductors.
Under particular conditions, their conductivity lies between that of good conductors and good insulators.
More importantly, their conductivity can change greatly with temperature, illumination, or the addition of small amounts of selected impurities.

resolvedSectionBreaks.before: One measurement showing an intermediate conductivity is not enough to classify an arbitrary material as a semiconductor.
resolvedSectionBreaks.after:
Early in the development of semiconductor technology, many electronic and radio devices relied mainly on conductors and insulators.
The original textbook's account of the earlier limited use of semiconductors describes that stage of technological development, not their role today.
